title: When will you read the three plugin page rows?
context: The issue says to read three rows on the plugin page in full before any code, and only you can open that page: the plugin.json row on naming files, the table.ts credential row, and the security scan's category on the Versions tab. If a row names something the issue does not cover, work done first may have to be redone, which is how the last four rounds went. Waiting costs a few minutes of your time and holds the build until then.
